messages:
Maya R.: Quick escalation: Brightwell needs to close renewal this week but procurement says no PO this quarter, only card. They asked if we can accept a card deposit for the renewal and allow them to issue a PO later as a record.
Arjun P.: Renewal is $120k/yr. If we take card for full amount, network limits and fees could be a problem. Do they have AMEX limits? :thinking:
Maya R.: They mentioned AMEX limit concerns. Prefer not to put full amount on card. Suggested split deposit.
Lina G.: Finance prefers a deposit on card + invoice for balance. For EU customers we also need VAT handling and billing entity id. What's their billing entity?
Maya R.: Brightwell EU, VAT GB999888777. They've offered to provide invoice address.
Tom (Legal): We can accept Docusign for SOW. For accepting card + retro PO, legal note: PO issued after payment cannot be used as proof of payment. We should include a clause clarifying that payment made by card supersedes later PO for accounting purposes. I'll draft short language.
Amir (AM): Also ask CS to add a metadata field on the invoice like `PO: <retro-po-number>` so their AP can match records later.
Lina G.: Agreed. Finance can add a PO metadata field but will record payment as card. If they insist on fee pass-through, we need signoff.
Maya R.: Customer asked if Redwood will absorb processing fees this time. They said procurement will only approve card if fees are minimal.
Arjun P.: Our rule: we can absorb small processing fees for renewals to avoid friction, but need to cap it and record as one-off concession. Recommend absorbing up to $2k for this transaction and documenting it.
Tom (Legal): Addendum language: `Processing fees for this transaction will be borne by Redwood Inference as a one-time accommodation.` Also add fallback: `If card charge fails, Redwood will notify the customer and temporarily suspend provisioning until alternate payment (PO/wire) is arranged.`
Maya R.: Proposed flow to customer:
1) Customer signs SOW in DocuSign (electronic signature).
2) Customer provides CC to be charged for $20,000 deposit on 2026-04-02.
3) Redwood issues invoice for remaining $100,000 (30 net). Customer may later provide PO number to be recorded on the invoice.
4) If charge fails, fallback to PO/wire path.
Lina G.: Finance requests: include EU billing entity id on invoice, VAT amount line, and `PO (optional)` metadata field. Provide an invoice preview link before charging.
Maya R.: I'll hold send until legal & finance confirm wording. Brightwell wants to sign by Fri EOD.
Tom (Legal): Draft addendum uploaded: https://docs.redwood/legal/addenda/card-deposit-retro-po-v1.docx  small redlines inline.
BillingBot: Invoice preview generated: https://billing.redwood/inv/preview/BW-2026-04-deposit (deposit $20,000).
Lina G.: Reviewing invoice preview now. Will confirm VAT calculation and accounting codes in ~1h.
Arjun P.: Once legal approves wording and finance confirms invoice, CS to send bundle: SOW (DocuSign link), invoice preview, and payment instructions. Set Salesforce renewal stage to `pending-cc-deposit`.
Maya R.: Will wait for green from Tom + Lina. Also noted: customer asked for receipt immediately after card capture. Ensure BillingBot emails receipt on success.
BillingBot: Payment capture scheduled for 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC (card on file). Receipt email will be auto-sent on successful capture.
Tom (Legal): Legal reviewed and approved addendum with one minor tweak to refund language. Approved.
Lina G.: Finance confirmed VAT ID and invoice metadata. Everything looks good from finance side.
Maya R.: Thanks all. Sending to customer now (SOW + addendum + invoice preview + instructions). Will update thread after capture or if customer requests PO modifications. :thumbsup:
